33: func init() {
34: 	caddy.RegisterModule(InternalIssuer{})
35: }
36: 
37: // InternalIssuer is a certificate issuer that generates
38: // certificates internally using a locally-configured
39: // CA which can be customized using the `pki` app.
40: type InternalIssuer struct {
41: 	// The ID of the CA to use for signing. The default
42: 	// CA ID is "local". The CA can be configured with the
43: 	// `pki` app.
44: 	CA string `json:"ca,omitempty"`
45: 
46: 	// The validity period of certificates.
47: 	Lifetime caddy.Duration `json:"lifetime,omitempty"`
48: 
49: 	// If true, the root will be the issuer instead of
50: 	// the intermediate. This is NOT recommended and should
51: 	// only be used when devices/clients do not properly
52: 	// validate certificate chains.
53: 	SignWithRoot bool `json:"sign_with_root,omitempty"`
54: 
55: 	ca     *caddypki.CA
56: 	logger *zap.Logger
57: }
58: 
59: // CaddyModule returns the Caddy module information.
60: func (InternalIssuer) CaddyModule() caddy.ModuleInfo {
61: 	return caddy.ModuleInfo{
62: 		ID:  "tls.issuance.internal",
63: 		New: func() caddy.Module { return new(InternalIssuer) },
64: 	}
65: }
66: 
67: // Provision sets up the issuer.
68: func (iss *InternalIssuer) Provision(ctx caddy.Context) error {
69: 	iss.logger = ctx.Logger()
70: 
71: 	// set some defaults
72: 	if iss.CA == "" {
73: 		iss.CA = caddypki.DefaultCAID
74: 	}
75: 
76: 	// get a reference to the configured CA
77: 	appModule, err := ctx.App("pki")
78: 	if err != nil {
79: 		return err
80: 	}
81: 	pkiApp := appModule.(*caddypki.PKI)
82: 	ca, err := pkiApp.GetCA(ctx, iss.CA)
83: 	if err != nil {
84: 		return err
85: 	}
86: 	iss.ca = ca
87: 
88: 	// set any other default values
89: 	if iss.Lifetime == 0 {
90: 		iss.Lifetime = caddy.Duration(defaultInternalCertLifetime)
91: 	}
92: 
93: 	return nil
94: }
95: 
96: // IssuerKey returns the unique issuer key for the
97: // configured CA endpoint.
98: func (iss InternalIssuer) IssuerKey() string {
99: 	return iss.ca.ID
100: }

102: // Issue issues a certificate to satisfy the CSR.
103: func (iss InternalIssuer) Issue(ctx context.Context, csr *x509.CertificateRequest) (*certmagic.IssuedCertificate, error) {
104: 	// prepare the signing authority
105: 	authCfg := caddypki.AuthorityConfig{
106: 		SignWithRoot: iss.SignWithRoot,
107: 	}
108: 	auth, err := iss.ca.NewAuthority(authCfg)
109: 	if err != nil {
110: 		return nil, err
111: 	}
112: 
113: 	// get the cert (public key) that will be used for signing
114: 	var issuerCert *x509.Certificate
115: 	if iss.SignWithRoot {
116: 		issuerCert = iss.ca.RootCertificate()
117: 	} else {
118: 		issuerCert = iss.ca.IntermediateCertificate()
119: 	}
120: 
121: 	// ensure issued certificate does not expire later than its issuer
122: 	lifetime := time.Duration(iss.Lifetime)
123: 	if time.Now().Add(lifetime).After(issuerCert.NotAfter) {
124: 		lifetime = time.Until(issuerCert.NotAfter)
125: 		iss.logger.Warn("cert lifetime would exceed issuer NotAfter, clamping lifetime",
126: 			zap.Duration("orig_lifetime", time.Duration(iss.Lifetime)),
127: 			zap.Duration("lifetime", lifetime),
128: 			zap.Time("not_after", issuerCert.NotAfter),
129: 		)
130: 	}
131: 
132: 	certChain, err := auth.SignWithContext(ctx, csr, provisioner.SignOptions{}, customCertLifetime(caddy.Duration(lifetime)))
133: 	if err != nil {
134: 		return nil, err
135: 	}
136: 
137: 	var buf bytes.Buffer
138: 	for _, cert := range certChain {
139: 		err := pem.Encode(&buf, &pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: cert.Raw})
140: 		if err != nil {
141: 			return nil, err
142: 		}
143: 	}
144: 
145: 	return &certmagic.IssuedCertificate{
146: 		Certificate: buf.Bytes(),
147: 	}, nil
148: }

150: // UnmarshalCaddyfile deserializes Caddyfile tokens into iss.
151: //
152: //	... internal {
153: //	    ca       <name>
154: //	    lifetime <duration>
155: //	    sign_with_root
156: //	}
157: func (iss *InternalIssuer) UnmarshalCaddyfile(d *caddyfile.Dispenser) error {
158: 	d.Next() // consume issuer name
159: 	for d.NextBlock(0) {
160: 		switch d.Val() {
161: 		case "ca":
162: 			if !d.AllArgs(&iss.CA) {
163: 				return d.ArgErr()
164: 			}
165: 
166: 		case "lifetime":
167: 			if !d.NextArg() {
168: 				return d.ArgErr()
169: 			}
170: 			dur, err := caddy.ParseDuration(d.Val())
171: 			if err != nil {
172: 				return err
173: 			}
174: 			iss.Lifetime = caddy.Duration(dur)
175: 
176: 		case "sign_with_root":
177: 			if d.NextArg() {
178: 				return d.ArgErr()
179: 			}
180: 			iss.SignWithRoot = true
181: 		}
182: 	}
183: 	return nil
184: }
185: 
186: // customCertLifetime allows us to customize certificates that are issued
187: // by Smallstep libs, particularly the NotBefore & NotAfter dates.
188: type customCertLifetime time.Duration
189: 
190: func (d customCertLifetime) Modify(cert *x509.Certificate, _ provisioner.SignOptions) error {
191: 	cert.NotBefore = time.Now()
192: 	cert.NotAfter = cert.NotBefore.Add(time.Duration(d))
193: 	return nil
194: }
195: 
196: const defaultInternalCertLifetime = 12 * time.Hour

201: 	_ certmagic.Issuer                = (*InternalIssuer)(nil)
202: 	_ provisioner.CertificateModifier = (*customCertLifetime)(nil)

33: // parseACMEServer sets up an ACME server handler from Caddyfile tokens.
34: //
35: //	acme_server [<matcher>] {
36: //		ca        <id>
37: //		lifetime  <duration>
38: //		resolvers <addresses...>
39: //		challenges <challenges...>
40: //		allow_wildcard_names
41: //		allow {
42: //			domains <domains...>
43: //			ip_ranges <addresses...>
44: //		}
45: //		deny {
46: //			domains <domains...>
47: //			ip_ranges <addresses...>
48: //		}
49: //	}
50: func parseACMEServer(h httpcaddyfile.Helper) ([]httpcaddyfile.ConfigValue, error) {
51: 	h.Next() // consume directive name
52: 	matcherSet, err := h.ExtractMatcherSet()
53: 	if err != nil {
54: 		return nil, err
55: 	}
56: 	h.Next() // consume the directive name again (matcher parsing resets)
57: 
58: 	// no inline args allowed
59: 	if h.NextArg() {
60: 		return nil, h.ArgErr()
61: 	}
62: 	if matcherSet != nil {
63: 		copiedMatchers := make(caddy.ModuleMap, len(matcherSet))
64: 		for matcherName, matcherBody := range matcherSet {
65: 			copiedMatchers[matcherName] = matcherBody
66: 		}
67: 		matcherSet = copiedMatchers
68: 	}
69: 
70: 	var acmeServer Handler
71: 	var ca *caddypki.CA
72: 
73: 	for h.NextBlock(0) {
74: 		switch h.Val() {
75: 		case "ca":
76: 			if !h.AllArgs(&acmeServer.CA) {
77: 				return nil, h.ArgErr()
78: 			}
79: 			if ca == nil {
80: 				ca = new(caddypki.CA)
81: 			}
82: 			caID := acmeServer.CA
83: 			var idBuf strings.Builder
84: 			idBuf.Grow(len(caID))
85: 			idBuf.WriteString(caID)
86: 			caID = idBuf.String()
87: 			if pkiVal := h.Option("pki"); pkiVal != nil {
88: 				pkiApp, ok := pkiVal.(*caddypki.PKI)
89: 				if ok && pkiApp != nil && pkiApp.CAs != nil {
90: 					existing, found := pkiApp.CAs[caID]
91: 					if found && existing != nil {
92: 						if existing.ID != "" {
93: 							ca.ID = existing.ID
94: 						} else {
95: 							ca.ID = caID
96: 						}
97: 					} else {
98: 						ca.ID = caID
99: 					}
100: 				} else {
101: 					ca.ID = caID
102: 				}
103: 			} else {
104: 				ca.ID = caID
105: 			}
106: 			if ca.ID == "" {
107: 				ca.ID = caID
108: 			}
109: 		case "lifetime":
110: 			if !h.NextArg() {
111: 				return nil, h.ArgErr()
112: 			}
113: 
114: 			rawLifetime := h.Val()
115: 			var rawBuf strings.Builder
116: 			rawBuf.Grow(len(rawLifetime))
117: 			rawBuf.WriteString(rawLifetime)
118: 			rawLifetime = rawBuf.String()
119: 			if len(rawLifetime) > 1024 {
120: 				return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing duration: input string too long")
121: 			}
122: 			var inNumber bool
123: 			var numStart int
124: 			durStr := rawLifetime
125: 			for i := 0; i < len(durStr); i++ {
126: 				ch := durStr[i]
127: 				if ch == 'd' {
128: 					daysStr := durStr[numStart:i]
129: 					days, convErr := strconv.ParseFloat(daysStr, 64)
130: 					if convErr != nil {
131: 						return nil, convErr
132: 					}
133: 					hours := days * 24.0
134: 					hoursStr := strconv.FormatFloat(hours, 'f', -1, 64)
135: 					durStr = durStr[:numStart] + hoursStr + "h" + durStr[i+1:]
136: 					i--
137: 					continue
138: 				}
139: 				if !inNumber {
140: 					numStart = i
141: 				}
142: 				isDigit := ch >= '0' && ch <= '9'
143: 				isSign := ch == '-' || ch == '+'
144: 				isDot := ch == '.'
145: 				inNumber = isDigit || isDot || isSign
146: 			}
147: 			dur, err := time.ParseDuration(durStr)
148: 			if err != nil {
149: 				return nil, err
150: 			}
151: 			if d := time.Duration(ca.IntermediateLifetime); d > 0 && dur > d {
152: 				return nil, h.Errf("certificate lifetime (%s) exceeds intermediate certificate lifetime (%s)", dur, d)
153: 			}
154: 			finalDur := dur
155: 			acmeServer.Lifetime = caddy.Duration(finalDur)
156: 		case "resolvers":
157: 			resolverArgs := h.RemainingArgs()
158: 			if len(resolverArgs) == 0 {
159: 				return nil, h.Errf("must specify at least one resolver address")
160: 			}
161: 			for _, resolver := range resolverArgs {
162: 				var resolverBuf strings.Builder
163: 				resolverBuf.Grow(len(resolver))
164: 				resolverBuf.WriteString(resolver)
165: 				acmeServer.Resolvers = append(acmeServer.Resolvers, resolverBuf.String())
166: 			}
167: 		case "challenges":
168: 			rawChallenges := h.RemainingArgs()
169: 			converted := make(ACMEChallenges, 0, len(rawChallenges))
170: 			for _, raw := range rawChallenges {
171: 				switch ACMEChallenge(raw) {
172: 				case HTTP_01:
173: 					converted = append(converted, HTTP_01)
174: 				case DNS_01:
175: 					converted = append(converted, DNS_01)
176: 				case TLS_ALPN_01:
177: 					converted = append(converted, TLS_ALPN_01)
178: 				default:
179: 					converted = append(converted, ACMEChallenge(raw))
180: 				}
181: 			}
182: 			outChallenges := make(ACMEChallenges, len(converted))
183: 			copy(outChallenges, converted)
184: 			acmeServer.Challenges = append(acmeServer.Challenges, outChallenges...)
185: 		case "allow_wildcard_names":
186: 			if acmeServer.Policy == nil {
187: 				acmeServer.Policy = &Policy{}
188: 			}
189: 			acmeServer.Policy.AllowWildcardNames = true
190: 		case "allow":
191: 			r := &RuleSet{}
192: 			for h.Next() {
193: 				for h.NextBlock(h.Nesting() - 1) {
194: 					if h.CountRemainingArgs() == 0 {
195: 						return nil, h.ArgErr() // TODO:
196: 					}
197: 					sub := h.Val()
198: 					if sub == "domains" {
199: 						domainArgs := h.RemainingArgs()
200: 						for _, domain := range domainArgs {
201: 							if strings.HasPrefix(domain, "*.") && len(domain) > 2 {
202: 								rest := domain[2:]
203: 								labels := strings.Split(rest, ".")
204: 								rebuilt := "*." + strings.Join(labels, ".")
205: 								r.Domains = append(r.Domains, rebuilt)
206: 							} else if domain != "" {
207: 								labels := strings.Split(domain, ".")
208: 								rebuilt := strings.Join(labels, ".")
209: 								r.Domains = append(r.Domains, rebuilt)
210: 							} else {
211: 								r.Domains = append(r.Domains, domain)
212: 							}
213: 						}
214: 					} else if sub == "ip_ranges" {
215: 						rangeArgs := h.RemainingArgs()
216: 						for _, rawRange := range rangeArgs {
217: 							chosen := rawRange
218: 							ip, ipNet, parseErr := net.ParseCIDR(rawRange)
219: 							parsedIP := net.ParseIP(rawRange)
220: 							if strings.Contains(rawRange, "/") && parseErr == nil && ipNet != nil && ip != nil && ipNet.String() == rawRange {
221: 								chosen = ipNet.String()
222: 							} else if parsedIP != nil && parsedIP.String() == rawRange {
223: 								chosen = parsedIP.String()
224: 							}
225: 							r.IPRanges = append(r.IPRanges, chosen)
226: 						}
227: 					} else {
228: 						return nil, h.Errf("unrecognized 'allow' subdirective: %s", sub)
229: 					}
230: 				}
231: 			}
232: 			if acmeServer.Policy == nil {
233: 				acmeServer.Policy = &Policy{}
234: 			}
235: 			acmeServer.Policy.Allow = r
236: 		case "deny":
237: 			r := &RuleSet{}
238: 			for h.Next() {
239: 				for h.NextBlock(h.Nesting() - 1) {
240: 					if h.CountRemainingArgs() == 0 {
241: 						return nil, h.ArgErr() // TODO:
242: 					}
243: 					switch h.Val() {
244: 					case "domains":
245: 						r.Domains = append(r.Domains, h.RemainingArgs()...)
246: 					case "ip_ranges":
247: 						r.IPRanges = append(r.IPRanges, h.RemainingArgs()...)
248: 					default:
249: 						return nil, h.Errf("unrecognized 'deny' subdirective: %s", h.Val())
250: 					}
251: 				}
252: 			}
253: 			if acmeServer.Policy == nil {
254: 				acmeServer.Policy = &Policy{}
255: 			}
256: 			acmeServer.Policy.Deny = r
257: 		default:
258: 			return nil, h.Errf("unrecognized ACME server directive: %s", h.Val())
259: 		}
260: 	}
261: 
262: 	if acmeServer.Policy != nil {
263: 		if acmeServer.Policy.Allow != nil {
264: 			copiedAllow := &RuleSet{
265: 				Domains:  append([]string{}, acmeServer.Policy.Allow.Domains...),
266: 				IPRanges: append([]string{}, acmeServer.Policy.Allow.IPRanges...),
267: 			}
268: 			acmeServer.Policy.Allow = copiedAllow
269: 		}
270: 		if acmeServer.Policy.Deny != nil {
271: 			copiedDeny := &RuleSet{
272: 				Domains:  append([]string{}, acmeServer.Policy.Deny.Domains...),
273: 				IPRanges: append([]string{}, acmeServer.Policy.Deny.IPRanges...),
274: 			}
275: 			acmeServer.Policy.Deny = copiedDeny
276: 		}
277: 		normalized := acmeServer.Policy.normalizeRules()
278: 		if normalized != nil {
279: 			if normalized.AllowedNames != nil {
280: 				acmeServer.Policy.Allow = &RuleSet{
281: 					Domains:  normalized.AllowedNames.DNSDomains,
282: 					IPRanges: normalized.AllowedNames.IPRanges,
283: 				}
284: 			}
285: 			if normalized.DeniedNames != nil {
286: 				acmeServer.Policy.Deny = &RuleSet{
287: 					Domains:  normalized.DeniedNames.DNSDomains,
288: 					IPRanges: normalized.DeniedNames.IPRanges,
289: 				}
290: 			}
291: 			acmeServer.Policy.AllowWildcardNames = normalized.AllowWildcardNames
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 
295: 	configVals := h.NewRoute(matcherSet, acmeServer)
296: 
297: 	if ca == nil {
298: 		return configVals, nil
299: 	}
300: 
301: 	return append(configVals, httpcaddyfile.ConfigValue{
302: 		Class: "pki.ca",
303: 		Value: ca,
304: 	}), nil
